biotools.summary: SuperBloom is a specialized Bloom filter variant designed to accelerate streaming k-mer queries in bioinformatics. It improves cache efficiency over traditional methods by grouping k-mers into memory blocks, making it suitable for read screening and contamination filtering.
biotools.name: SuperBloom: Super Bloom Filter for Streaming k-mer Queries
